GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down Outside Leader .5 Lengths 1000m 2nd .5 Lengths 600m eq lead home turn Hard Ridden 3rd weakened badly final 200m # on pace/gone 300m
jumped Just Ok . Settled Down 3 Wide No Cover 5th , 3 Lengths @ 800m. gave Ground steadily in Straight # 3w/faded Clear last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 1kg over the allotted weight of 55kg. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Near the 300m, rider dropped his whip.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide until Settled Down behind leader on rail (2L from lead). Stayed same until back 1 length @ 700m & pushed to chase on inside @ 400m. Pressured Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Two Wide in last 200m. # Struggled from turn
Jumped Ok bustled to lead 1 length clear, pushed along turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed approaching 200m and dropped out # led/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 lengths. looking for run turn. battled away when clear # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover in the early and middle stags of the event before obtaining cover near the 600m. laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Drifted Back off speed 5-6 Lengths (800m), Under Whip Turn , Straightened Up no closer plenty to do, doing best work very late # suited further
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider dropped her whip passing the 350m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear found 2 Lengths Soon After Straightening Up looking good until winner emerged x 100m, Beaten off x 50m, # led, gave all
Jumped Ok worked hard to settle outside leader. got to front turn. battled on very well. grabbed last stride # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide and without cover throughout the event. Over the concluding stages was inclined to lay inwards and had to be corrected by its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Went Forward early , Settled Down 3rd the fence 2 Lengths @ 1000m. Held Up on heels To The Turn but things opened up Immediately on Straightening Up . Every Chance from there. Kept Going Soundly # sound effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly during the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off, eased 3 Wide improving turn, took over Straightening Up , drew 1 length clear passing 200m, same 100m, kept on well late holding margin # had run/did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider got her whip tangled in her reins for some distance near the 100m.
